transcript.text:
Thanks for joining, everyone. Before I finalize the operating structure for the onboarding refresh, I need to go through our standard planning intake. As you know, Nia and Omar have been working on this six-week refresh, and I want to make sure we set up a clear structure: one accountable lead, one reviewer, a recurring working-session day, and a named person for the kickoff.

Before I assign anything, I need each of you to formally disclose any availability constraints, certifications, or prior commitments that could affect role assignments. Please share anything relevant — specific days you're unavailable, workload caps, certifications you hold, or standing commitments — so I can record them properly before we lock in the structure. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should go first. I have an approved six-week caregiving arrangement that limits my onboarding-refresh work to exactly 6 hours per week. It also makes me unavailable for recurring sessions on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Friday — Thursday is the only weekday I'm available for a recurring session.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should go next. I completed the company's facilitator certification last month, which qualifies me to serve as the accountable lead under our planning policy. I also want to note that I promised the onboarding sponsor that I would lead the refresh kickoff — it was an informal promise and isn't in the project notes, but I want to disclose it here so it's on record as a prior commitment.
transcript.speaker: A3
